rarefaction effects are significant for transonic airfoil flows at low Reynolds numbers, and that the flow separation is delayed and the aerodynamic performance is improved as the rarefaction effects are considered.

The rarefaction effects on airfoils at low Reynolds numbers are significant, and the rarefaction effects on the airfoil aerodynamics can be quantified using the modified Newtonian theory (MNT) with an empirical coefficient of rarefaction effects.
